findings.title: Finalize restamps stale execution receipts
findings.finding: The finalizer replaces source_tree_sha256 on every mutable receipt with the current source digest without invoking the registered producer command.
findings.plain_english_risk: A browser, e2e, security, mechanical, or clean-clone run captured against older code can be made to look current and then pass the freshness and manifest-pin checks.
findings.recommended_fix: Never mutate producer-owned source identity. Rerun every registered producer after the final source snapshot, or retain the original source digest and block until a newly produced receipt matches it.

findings.title: NIMA accepts invalid score payloads
findings.finding: scoreNima accepts any JavaScript number and returns the whole unvalidated payload even though the documented contract is a 1-10 score with a histogram.
findings.plain_english_risk: A broken local scorer can return an out-of-range value such as 11, which is then treated as an acceptable aesthetic result instead of an unavailable measurement.
findings.recommended_fix: Require a finite score in the documented inclusive range and validate or remove the histogram contract; add malformed, Infinity, negative, zero, and above-range tests.

findings.title: Release-gate output can follow a symlink outside the verifier root
findings.finding: The input path resolver checks real paths, but the output resolver performs only a lexical prefix check before writeFileSync follows the destination or a parent symlink.
findings.plain_english_risk: A repository-controlled symlink can redirect --out writes outside the verifier root when the gate CLI runs in a more privileged environment.
findings.recommended_fix: Reject symlink components and verify the real parent remains below the real verifier root, then create the output atomically with no-follow semantics.
